dct_description_sm: Abstract: King County, Washington Wastewater Treatment Division's major sewage conveyance system (sewer lines). Covers also a portion of Snohomish County.

Purpose: This datalayer depicts King County Wastewater Treatment Division's conveyance system. It is generated from the Facility Information Retrieval System (FIRS), a database maintained by the Wastewater Treatment Division, Facility Inspection Section. Segments represent sections of conveyance pipe between manholes or other facilities (see the King County, Washington : Wastewater Treatment Division (WTD) facilities point layer).

Access constraints: Access is granted to Harvard University Affiliates only. Affiliates are limited to current faculty, staff and students.
